Test Title: Verify All Features on the Checkout Page are Visible
Description: Validate that the UI elements on the Checkout Information page are displayed correctly with expected placeholders and text.
Pre-conditions:
2. The browser is launched.
2. The user navigates to the application Base URL.
3. The user logs in successfully with a valid account (valid_user).
4. Test data is loaded from checkoutInfo fixture.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Cart page.
2. Click the "Checkout" button.
3. Verify the Checkout container exists.
4. Verify the page title is "Checkout: Your Information".
5. Verify "First Name" input placeholder.
6. Verify "Last Name" input placeholder.
7. Verify "Zip/Postal Code" input placeholder.
8. Verify "Cancel" button text.
9. Verify "Continue" button value.
Expected:
1. All elements are visible.
2. Placeholders match "First Name", "Last Name", "Zip/Postal Code".
3. Buttons are labeled "Cancel" and "Continue".

Test Title: Verify User Cannot Access the "Checkout: Overview" Page Without Filling All Details
Description: Validate mandatory field error messages are displayed sequentially when fields are missing.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Scenario A: Leave all fields empty and click "Continue".
Check: Error message "Error: First Name is required" is displayed.
3. Close the error message.
4. Scenario B: Enter First Name only and click "Continue".
Check: Error message "Error: Last Name is required" is displayed.
5. Close the error message.
6. Scenario C: Enter Zip Code (keeping First Name filled, Last Name empty) and click "Continue".
Check: Error message "Error: Last Name is required" is displayed.
Expected:
1. The user remains on the Checkout Information page.
2. Specific error messages appear based on the missing field.

Test Title: Verify User is Unable to Proceed with Invalid Details
Description: Validate system behavior when invalid data formats are entered (based on InvalidcheckoutInfo data).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Enter invalid First Name, Last Name, and Zip Code.
3. Click "Continue"
Expected: 1. An error message containing the text "Invalid" is displayed.

Test Title: Verify User can Proceed to "Checkout: Overview" Page with Valid Details
Description: Validate successful navigation to the Overview page when valid data is provided.
Steps:
1. Ensure a product  is added to the cart.
2. Navigate to the Checkout page.
3. Enter valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip Code 
4. Click "Continue".
Expected:
1. User is redirected to the Checkout Overview page.
2. The Checkout Overview page title is visible.

Test Title: Verify Cancel Button Redirects to Cart Page
Description: Validate that the Cancel button navigates the user back to the Cart page.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Click the "Cancel" button.
Expected:
1. The URL contains /cart.html.
2. The page title "Your Cart" is displayed.

Test Title: Verify Error Message When Zip/Postal Code is Missing
Description: Specific validation ensuring the Zip Code is required when Name fields are populated.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Enter a valid First Name.
3. Enter a valid Last Name.
4. Leave Zip/Postal Code empty.
5. Click "Continue".
Expected: 1. Error message "Error: Postal Code is required" is displayed.

Test Title: Verify Visual Error Indicators on Validation Failure
Description: Validate that input fields visually indicate errors (CSS classes and icons) upon validation failure.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Click "Continue" (triggering validation errors).
Expected:
1. First Name, Last Name, and Zip Code fields have the error CSS class (turning them red).
2. Three error icons (svg.error_icon) are visible on the form.

Test Title: Verify Form Fields are Cleared When Navigating Away and Returning
Description: Validate that form data is not persisted if the user cancels and returns to the checkout page.
Steps:
1. Click the Cart icon to navigate to the Cart page.
2. Click the Checkout button to navigate to the "Checkout: Your Information" page.
3. Enter a valid First Name into the First Name field.
4. Enter a valid Last Name into the Last Name field.
5. Enter a valid Zip/Postal Code into the Zip Code field.
6. Click the Continue button (User is redirected to "Checkout: Overview" page).
7. Click the Cancel button on the Overview page.
8. Verify the user is redirected to the Inventory page (/inventory.html).
9. Click the Cart icon again.
10. Click the Checkout button again to return to the "Checkout: Your Information" page.
11. Inspect the values of the First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code fields.
Expected:
1. The First Name field is empty.
2. The Last Name field is empty.
3. The Zip/Postal Code field is empty. (This confirms that sensitive user data is not persisted in the form fields after the flow is cancelled and restarted).
